name: Mono-101
author: sd88me
summary: A circuit-modelled SH-101 mono synth: a port of the Lemus engine, which solves the original schematic part by part, modified for the MPC. The manual's 40 sample sounds, user presets named on screen, and a Circuit Bent page based on Nova-mod and more (PWM, triangle VCO, overdrive, VCF FM, LFO range, key trigger, tempo sync). Gen2 only, CPU heavy.
